# Common updates

Nearly every update during the conference year takes one command, run
from the project root:

    Rscript scripts/build-site.R

This pulls the Sheet into the local files, renders the whole site, and
runs the accessibility and link checks. At the end it tells you whether
everything passed. If a check finds something, the script prints what
and where so you can fix it before committing. The link check always
finds a handful of references buried in the archived email newsletters;
those are expected, and the script says so when that is all it found.

The update script copies the Sheet into local files the pages read, so
what you see after rendering is exactly what the Sheet says. The Sheet's
tabs and columns are listed in the comment at the top of
`conferences/_update-conference.R`.

When you only want to preview a small change, the manual three-step
routine still works:

1. Edit the **AP-LS Conference** Google Sheet.
2. Run `source("conferences/_update-conference.R")` from the project root
   in RStudio.
3. Render just the conference pages and check them in the browser.

## Open the call for proposals

1. In the `info` tab, set `submissions_note` (the line on the main page),
   `cfp_note` (the line on the CFP page), `cfp_deadline`,
   `submission_portal_url`, and `reviewer_form_url`.
2. Run the update script.
3. Open `conferences/cfp/index.qmd` and follow the STAGE 2 comment at the
   top: delete the comment markers so the full call becomes visible, add
   this year's theme, and check the session limits against this year's
   policy. The deadline and links fill in from the Sheet on their own.
4. Render `conferences/cfp/index.qmd` and `conferences/index.qmd`.

## Add a preconference workshop

1. Add one row to the `workshops` tab: slug (a folder name like
   `workshop_1`), title, subtitle, date, presenters, categories,
   description, learning objectives, CE credits, and times. Separate
   multiple presenters or objectives with semicolons.
2. Run the update script. It builds a page for each workshop in
   `conferences/preconference/`, and the workshops grid fills in on its
   own.
3. When the first workshop goes up, set `sort-ui` and `filter-ui` to
   `true` in `conferences/preconference/index.qmd`.
4. Render `conferences/preconference/`.

Workshops can go up one at a time as they are confirmed. To remove one,
delete its row from the Sheet, re-run the script, and delete its folder
(the script warns about folders that are not in the Sheet and leaves them
untouched).

## Open the room block

In the `info` tab, set `hotel_note` (for example, "The 20XX room block is
now available! Book directly through the hotel for the discounted rate.")
and `hotel_booking_url`. Run the script and render the main page. The
booking callout with the Book Room button appears on its own.

## Update the schedule

Set `schedule_note` in the `info` tab, then run the script and render the
main page. If the program is a PDF, keep it in `conferences/files/` and
link it from the Schedule section of `conferences/index.qmd`.

## Open registration

1. In the `info` tab, set `registration_note` and `registration_url`.
2. Put the final prices in the `registration-rates` tab, and the workshop
   prices in the `workshop-rates` tab. Keep `rates_note` accurate: it says
   which year the rates are based on until the new rates are set.
3. Run the script and render the main page and the preconference page.
   The Register button appears on its own.

## Add images

Save conference images in `conferences/images/` and resize and compress
them before adding. Large images are the main reason pages load slowly.
The naming and size rules are in `UPDATING.md` under "Image guidelines".
